content.comment_body: Good afternoon, is it possible to set up different password levels for [product_name] Web Editor? I need separate access for operator and administrator roles. Thanks, [user_name]
To my knowledge, that's not possible. Can you explain why you need this feature?
The goal is for operators to be able to switch certain functions on and off in [product_name] Web Editor, while administrators would have access to all settings and functions.
As mentioned before, this isn't possible with the current setup.
Is this feature available in other types of [company_name] controllers like [version_no]?

[product_name] Web Editor is mainly a construction tool for creating web pages; it runs in the extended web editor of [product_name]. If a [version_no] and its web server can meet your requirements, I'm not sure. You may want to ask in the [version_no] forum for details.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have discovered that the current web editor software does not support multiple password levels for different user roles, such as operator and administrator, limiting the implementation of granular access control. This restriction affects those who need differentiated permissions within their application.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to configure multiple password levels to allow specific access rights according to their roles, providing enhanced security and flexibility between operator and administrator functions.
